'''Tapalo''' was the [[Parent/Legends|father]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|monarch]] candidate [[Bon Tapalo/Legends|Bon Tapalo]]. According to the patriarch of [[House Palpatine/Legends|House Palpatine]], [[Cosinga Palpatine]], his [[Cosinga Palpatine's grandfather|grandfather]] challenged the elder Tapalo in an honor duel at House Palpatine's ancestral home, [[Convergence/Legends|Convergence]], around [[135 BBY/Legends|135 BBY]] upon discovering that the houses of [[House Tapalo|Tapalo]] and [[House Veruna|Veruna]] had manipulated the then-current [[Gungan–Naboo War|Naboo-Gungan war]] to harness the [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] reserves. He managed to deliver mortal wounds to Cosinga Palpatine's grandfather.
